note: edit_dashboard's live MCP input schema, split by operation for cheap lookup. This file is the envelope only (dashboardIdOrApiName + autosave + operations + minorVersion). Each operations[] item is discriminated by its 'operation' field — read the sibling file named '<operation-value>.json' in this same directory for that operation's exact required fields, properties, and a worked example. Don't guess a payload shape from prose when you can Read the fragment. Cross-cutting widget fields (actions, dynamicTokens, style blocks, receive-sources, conditional formatting) shared by every upsert_*_widget op live once in '_shared-widget-fields.json' — read it alongside a widget op when you need one of those fields.

dashboardIdOrApiName.description: The id (0FK...) or apiName of the dashboard the operations apply to. REQUIRED.

autosave.description: Batch-wide persistence mode (top-level — NOT per-operation). false (default) stages the final dashboard as an unsaved draft; true persists once after every operation succeeds. Ignored when a save_dashboard, undo, or discard_dashboard control operation determines the outcome.

operations.description: Ordered, non-empty list of operations applied atomically in order (all-or-nothing). Each item is one operation, discriminated by its 'operation' field. For upsert_*_widget: provide widget.id to fully replace that persisted widget (also requires widget.name and widget.type to match it); omit id to create a new widget. An ID-less same-name widget may be replaced only when it is an unsaved draft. Each upsert is a complete replacement (omitted fields are dropped) and does not place the widget or change existing placements.

items.description: One operation. Look up its full shape by filename: '<operation>.json' in this directory, where <operation> is this item's 'operation' value.

minorVersion.description: Minor version supported for the API. Always send -1 (latest supported minor version) — the single-value enum forces this so a compliant client always emits it. NOT a dashboard revision.
